sources.title: Libyan News Agency: activation of E-VISA LIBYA
sources.officialityEvidence: LANA is Libya's state news agency. Its 29 June 2026 report reproduces the Government circular identifying E-VISA LIBYA as the approved national electronic-visa platform.
sources.supportingExcerpt: باعتبارهما المنصة الوطنية المعتمدة لإدارة التأشيرات الإلكترونية

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: live ordinary-passport and visa-type configuration
sources.officialityEvidence: The live resource behind evisa.gov.ly identifies the regular passport type and electronic visa type. LANA's current government circular identifies E-VISA LIBYA as the approved national platform.

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: live Türkiye country configuration
sources.officialityEvidence: The live public national-platform country configuration directly returns Türkiye with its ISO code, availability, exemption type, online-application setting and visa-delivery type. It is used only for the positive Türkiye record, not as a complement for other codes.

sources.title: E-VISA LIBYA: live Türkiye demographic eligibility checker
sources.officialityEvidence: The public evisa.gov.ly checker submits regular-passport nationality, date of birth and gender to this endpoint. On 24 August 2026, Türkiye returned PROCEED21 for MALE/1990-01-01 and CNTRYEXEMPT23 for FEMALE/2010-01-01 and MALE/1940-01-01. These samples establish a material demographic split, without isolating age from gender, not a passport-wide result.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: demographic-dependent exemption and electronic-application cohorts
conflicts.explanation: Libya's live national platform marks Türkiye as PARTIAL. Its public ordinary-passport checker returned different outcomes for sampled date-of-birth and gender combinations, so the passport-wide visa-free fallback cannot be normalized.

unresolved.reason: No current Libyan or Israeli passport-government source directly establishes an ordinary Israeli-passport short-visitor route and its issuance timing. Absence from the national platform is not treated as proof of prohibition, exemption or a visa route.

No current Libyan or Uruguayan passport-government source directly maps an ordinary Uruguayan passport to a short-visitor Libyan route and actual issuance timing. The platform is not used as an omission-based complement.

The live platform explicitly lists Taiwan as unavailable, but no current primary source states whether that represents recognition, prohibition, a mission route or another status. No ordinary Taiwan-passport visitor result is normalized.

No current Libyan or Russian passport-government source directly maps an ordinary Russian passport to a short-visitor Libyan route and actual issuance timing. Portal availability or general consular filing is not treated as eligibility evidence.

Libya's live ordinary-passport checker returned different outcomes for sampled Turkish date-of-birth and gender combinations. The samples do not isolate which demographic field controls the split, and the passport-code model represents neither, so no single visitor status is safe.

The live platform explicitly lists Kosovo as unavailable, but no current primary source directly states the ordinary Kosovo-passport visitor route, recognition consequence or issuance timing. Unavailability is not normalized as a visa status.

No current Libyan or Rwandan passport-government source directly maps an ordinary Rwandan passport to a Libyan short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. No inference is made from platform coverage or omissions.

The live platform explicitly lists South Sudan as unavailable, but no current primary source directly establishes the ordinary South Sudanese-passport visitor route or actual issuance timing. Non-availability is not treated as a prohibition or advance-visa result.
